acceptance_criteria.description: Canonical per-source records validate provenance, identities, conditions, evidence tier, metrics, assets, and supersession while rejecting unsafe or ambiguous input.
Generated sources, catalog, observations, and assets views combine BMP and historical records without changing existing BMP table semantics or claim eligibility.
Each source snapshot and record is independently mergeable without a hand-edited global index, and duplicate or conflicting logical identities fail closed.
Import-only changes trigger required offline CI and never require public CI to access private repositories.

objective: Add strict content-addressed historical import records and generated sources, catalog, observations, and assets views without changing BMP execution or treating legacy data as standalone-verified evidence.
title: Add provenance-safe historical benchmark imports
